🚨🚨 BIG UPDATE: A 10-month-old child in Assam has tested positive for human metapneumovirus (HMPV), the first case reported this season. 

The child is stable and receiving treatment at Assam Medical College in Dibrugarh. #Assam #HMPV #healt
